text:
ConocoPhillips rose 1.6% today, continuing a strong three-day rally that's added about $7 to the stock price since Monday. The gain follows heating oil prices jumping 59% from last year—a spike that signals robust demand for petroleum products heading into winter, which supports crude prices and the company's production economics. Oil prices have also firmed, with U.S. crude at $89.62 per barrel, providing a steady backdrop for energy producers.

The broader context is more complicated. Russian crude production has rebounded sharply to 8.73 million barrels per day in October, pushing global oil markets into surplus—a dynamic that typically pressures prices and producer profits. This headwind explains why the stock is still down 7.6% over the past two weeks despite today's bounce; the recent rally appears to reflect near-term strength in heating demand rather than confidence in longer-term supply-demand balance.
